market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Susan Collins is a moderate Republican with strong cross-party appeal who has not announced retirement. Maine has a strong tradition of split-ticket voting and re-electing incumbents, even in years when the state votes Democratic at the presidential level. Her 2020 victory in a Biden-winning state demonstrates resilience. The market-implied 22.5% appears too low given these fundamentals, underpricing a Republican hold.
evidence_points: Collins won re-election in 2020 with 51% despite Biden carrying Maine by 8 points
No credible retirement indication; Collins consistently emphasises her bipartisan reputation
Maine's incumbent re-election rate in Senate races is historically high
